rows.objective: Build an accessible responsive UI component from explicit behavior, design and device constraints

rows.objective: Prepare a bounded hazard-control and test matrix for a simulated robot or IoT workflow without actuating devices
inputs: declared hazard list and target safety controls
simulation capabilities and human authorization rules
outputs: offline negative-test matrix with stop conditions
unverified physical-world assumptions and approval requirements
acceptance_criteria: Every cited hazard has an explicit control and testable failure criterion
Unproven physical behavior is not treated as validated by simulation
No live control command, actuator motion or safety override occurs
failure_modes: No trusted simulator or risk boundaries
Unapproved command would operate physical equipment
rows.refusal_rule: If source, authorization, prerequisite, expert review, or necessary context is unavailable, report the explicit gap or refuse the consequential action.

acceptance_criteria: Claims are linked to the actual cited study or guideline version
